description: Small single-turn loops: the radiation resistance referred to the loop's mean-square current (R_loop = 2 P_rad / <|I|^2>) and the lossless Q_Z of the loop tuned by a series capacitor (Q_rad), which small_circular_loop and small_square_loop build their efficiency, Q and wire sizing on. Circle: the Fourier-mode solution (otahub.num.loop_modal), delta gap, at 60 and 40 modes - both quantities move under 0.01% between them where the terminal resistance moves 35%. Square: the method of moments (otahub.num.mom), segments s/(4b), 8 to 40 a side. Geometry in wavelengths; every third size held out of the fits.

circle.columns: C = circumference/lambda, ba = wire radius / loop radius

square.columns: P = perimeter/lambda, bs = wire radius / side, n = segments a side

directivity.columns: x = size/lambda (circumference or perimeter), D = peak directivity of the solved current (method of moments, wire 0.01 of the loop radius or side, circle 64 segments, square 16 a side, 120 x 160 directions), D_axial broadside to the loop
